altitude.quote: The instrument is located on Cerro Toco in the Atacama Desert, at an altitude of 5190 meters.

coordinates.locator: ACT receiver and instrumentation paper (arXiv:1007.0290), telescope-parameter table "Location"
coordinates.note: 22 deg 57 min 31 sec S, 67 deg 47 min 15 sec W converted to decimal degrees; precision set to 100 m because the table gives whole arcseconds (1 arcsec is about 30 m).

name: ACT site, Cerro Toco
notes: The same ACT paper also reports the site as "on the slopes of Cerro Toco" (ACTPol instrument paper) and 5190 m altitude. POLARBEAR's James Ax Observatory stands about 150 m from this point, CLASS about 300 m (see their sites).

place.region: Antofagasta Region (Cerro Toco, near San Pedro de Atacama)

summary.plain: The mountainside on Cerro Toco, in northern Chile, where the six-metre Atacama Cosmology Telescope stood until it was decommissioned after it took its final data in 2022.
summary.technical: Site of the 6 m Atacama Cosmology Telescope on the slopes of Cerro Toco at 5190 m in the Parque Astronómico Atacama; ACT took its final data in 2022 and has been decommissioned.
